title: Mermaid Whiskey
summary: Use as 6 Camp Supplies, drink it to gain Alcohol, or throw it to create a flammable spill.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Gain Alcohol for 2 turns, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Throw: Action. Create a permanent 13 ft radius Alcohol surface. Fire ignites it and Cold freezes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
